title: A Safer Crossing for Pupils
transcript: Cars will no longer be allowed on Hill Road for thirty minutes before the start of classes at Park School. The rule begins on Monday and applies only during the school term. Residents who live on the road will still be able to drive to their homes. The council says it received complaints from parents about crowded pavements and unsafe crossings. Traffic officers will be present for the first week to explain the change to drivers.

questions.prompt: When will the driving restriction apply?
questions.explanation: 限制在上课前的三十分钟实施。
家长投诉人行道拥挤，过马路不安全。
